repair_instruction: The preceding response did not pass validation: {reason}. Return a new complete JSON result for the ORIGINAL supplied task. Do not invent facts or alter the input hash. Every evidence quote must be a literal continuous substring of title or abstract.
policy: Only an explicit --execute-ai may make requests. Saved responses are replayed by input, prompt, vocabulary, model and settings hashes. Each task is isolated. Authentication/balance errors stop new requests. Mechanical validation is not a semantic quality audit.
